A newly created **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65` (item IDs by class), applied via `createCharacter` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:59,65`), called from `POST /api/character/create` in `worker/src/routes/character.ts:11`. Item names/IDs come from the seeded `items` table in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Note: ID `23` is actually "Torches" despite code comments calling it "Rations" (bug B-09).
